name: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0
access: SpaceXAI ephemeral tokens for browser and mobile clients

voice.input_audio: audio/pcm (8000, 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100 or 48000 Hz), audio/pcmu, audio/pcma or audio/opus; sent as base64 JSON or as raw binary WebSocket frames [xai-s2s]
voice.output_audio: The same codecs and rates as the input, set separately; 24 kHz PCM is advised to avoid resampling; Opus is 24 kHz mono; playback speed 0.7 to 1.5 [xai-s2s]
voice.voices: 28 built-in voices on the text-to-speech page (default eve), and custom voices cloned from a short reference clip [xai-tts] [xai-s2s]
languages: 20 listed language variants with native-quality accents (English, Egyptian, Saudi and Emirati Arabic, Bengali, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian and European Portuguese, Russian, Mexican and European Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese); the model detects the input language and answers in it, and xAI says it can speak other languages with varying accuracy
voice.turn_detection: turn_detection.type server_vad detects the end of the user turn; null selects manual turns, where the client sends input_audio_buffer.commit and clear; idle_timeout_ms (default null) makes the server re-engage a silent user after that many milliseconds, again and again until the user speaks [xai-s2s]
voice.interruption: With server_vad, barge-in is automatic; in non-VAD mode response.cancel cancels a response; conversation.item.truncate trims an assistant audio item; a force_message item with interruptible false drops caller audio until its playback ends [xai-s2s] [xai-rest-voice]
voice.latency: xAI: 0.70 seconds to first audio for 2.0 against 1.25 seconds for 1.0 [xai-announce-2]; Artificial Analysis: 0.70 seconds on average on its Big Bench Audio set [aa-s2s]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Not per token. SpaceXAI pricing page (read 2026-10-03): US$0.08 per minute of speech-to-speech (US$4.80 per hour) and US$0.004 per text input. Rate limits are set by concurrent sessions per tier, from 10 at tier 0 to 200 at tier 4, not by tokens [xai-pricing] [xai-rates]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Reasoning (Big Bench Audio)
benchmarks.setting: model listed as Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 High; Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech page; 1,000 spoken questions adapted from Big Bench Hard

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Conversational Dynamics (Full Duplex Bench subset)
benchmarks.setting: weighted average of pause handling 97.8, turn-taking 90.8, interruption handling 97.0 and backchannel handling 94.9 from Full Duplex Bench v1 and v1.5

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Agentic Performance (tau-Voice)
benchmarks.setting: share of replica customer-service scenarios resolved; airline 56.0, retail 49.7, telecom 63.7; only full-duplex models are run

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech: arena preference Elo
benchmarks.setting: human participants compare two unnamed voice models on one scenario; the page lists only models with tool calling

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech: task success rate (percent)
benchmarks.setting: column labelled Task Success Rate on the page; the page text read does not define it further

unknown: context_window: not published for the voice model; its page lists no context figure

voice.duplex: full follows Artificial Analysis, which runs this model on its tau-Voice test for full-duplex models only; xAI's pages describe server VAD with automatic barge-in and do not use the word full-duplex [aa-s2s] [xai-s2s]
voice.session_limit: no maximum session length is stated; session resumption is optional and concurrent sessions are limited per tier [xai-s2s] [xai-rates]
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs; the price is per minute of audio, not per token
